en: This is a vintage postcard. The front shows a black-and-white photograph of a leafy urban square with a large fountain in the center, surrounded by ornate late 19th-century European buildings. Visible signage includes 'NORRLAND'. The lower left corner has printed text: 'Sundsvall. Vängåvan'. The reverse side has handwritten Swedish text, a stamp from Sweden reading 'SVERIGE 10', addressed to 'Fru Briken Lundström', and postmarked 'Sundsvall'.
